blind.thesis: Channel breakout fires after a ~4 ATR V-bounce off lows, so it chases; ADX is high but from the prior down-leg. 15 ATR target is unrealistic, trail does the work. Maxed confidence is suspicious.

Breakout above the 20-bar high after a sharp 5 ATR recovery with calm vol; momentum is real but entry is extended. 29 ATR target is nominal only, 2 ATR stop is sensible. Four same-way positions already open.
Sweep and displacement are valid, but entry is half an ATR above the gap instead of on a retrace into it, in a low-ADX chop tape. 3 ATR stop with a 1.5R target pays poorly for the chase.

Short sits on the trend midline mid-range, not at the top of a pullback, and the strategy's own confidence is low at 0.21. ADX supports a downtrend but the recent swings are choppy. Nine correlated shorts open.

Continuation short after a bounce faded back to flat, but price is below the midline and has ranged for a dozen bars with no fresh rejection. Confidence 0.16 is the weakest on the sheet; trend is aged.
Retrace into the gap after a heavy-volume displacement, with the stop beyond the sweep high and low ADX favouring reversal. Minus: the sweep is 11 bars old and vol is elevated, so the stop is wide.
Fading a vertical 6 ATR rally; entry is 1.6 ATR under the gap after the drop already happened, so the stop is 3.4 ATR for 1.5R. Six correlated shorts open. Sweep is clean but nothing left to harvest.

Same weak low-confidence continuation short in a stale trend, and it stacks on a same-direction position already open in this market, doubling exposure to one thesis. Tighter trail does not fix the entry.

Clean downtrend, a ~2.7 ATR bounce retraced to the upper part of the range and the last bar printed an upper-wick rejection. Confidence 0.77 and ADX 34 agree. Minor flaw: bounce momentum was still up.

Sweep plus full-body displacement is textbook, but entry is on the displacement close above the gap, and the bracket stop of 1.8 ATR sits well inside the 3.9 ATR structural stop. Tiny ATR makes costs heavy.

The gap was traded straight through and price closed back below the sweep area a few bars ago, so the setup is damaged; the long re-enters on a bounce above it. Chop, ADX 14, ten opposing positions open.
Breakdown through the 20-bar low on a large bearish bar with above-average volume, but it reverses a recent rally so whipsaw risk is real. Stop is 1.7 ATR vs the 2.5 ATR design, which is tight.
